description:
Spacious first floor two bedroom apartment (78.18 sq m.) situated in this popular development a stones throw from Pearse Street Dart station.  Accommodation comprises of an Entrance hall with two storage cupboards, a spacious living room with balcony, modern kitchen, bathroom with shower.  Two double bedrooms.

This apartment is located close to many amenities including Trinity College, Grand Canal Dock, IFSC, Theatres, Restaurants.

Viewing is highly recommended .
